about: The claims file (Prove): each sentence someone might repeat about the project, the command that measures it, and what the command must do for the claim to hold (exit with a code and, optionally, print some text). node tools/claims.mjs runs every command from the repository's root and writes the proof page: pass, fail or unknown, and when each was measured. A claim no command can measure yet has command null, and stays unknown.
